name: lumin-customer-app
description: Branded CUSTOMER ordering app (Capacitor, iOS + Android) — one shared codebase, one binary per shop generated from data/shops/<slug>/config.json's app block (the app-layer mirror of SHOP_SLUG). Self-contained — does not affect the web build or the LumiPOS till app in app/.

scripts.assets: capacitor-assets generate || echo 'asset generation skipped (install @capacitor/assets or add icons manually)'
scripts.prepare:android: npm run gen && npm run sync-web && cap add android && npm run patch-android && npm run assets
scripts.prepare:ios: npm run gen && npm run sync-web && cap add ios && npm run patch-ios && npm run assets
scripts.sync: npm run gen && npm run sync-web && cap sync && npm run patch-android
scripts.ota:publish: npm run gen && npm run sync-web && npx @capgo/cli@latest bundle upload --channel production
